title: Template:Infobox event/doc
content:
==Description== To use this template, copy the following code and fill in the appropriate fields. ==Syntax== 
{{infobox event
 | title         = 
 | image         = [e.g. "Example.jpg"]
 | imagewidth    = [e.g. "150"] [default: 210 pixels]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | participants  = 
 | date          = 
 | location      = 
}}
==Samples== 
{{infobox event
 | title         = Flower du Jour
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | participants  = Everyone
 | date          = All the time
 | location      = Everywhere
}}
Results in... {{infobox event | title = Flower du Jour | image = Example.jpg | participants = Everyone | date = All the time | location = Everywhere }} [[Category:Infobox templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
